headline: RBI issues Small Finance Banks KYC Second Amendment Directions, 2026
reference: Reserve Bank of India (Small Finance Banks - Know Your Customer) Second Amendment Directions, 2026
summary_points: RBI has published the Small Finance Banks - Know Your Customer Second Amendment Directions, 2026 on its notifications page.
The Directions amend the existing KYC framework applicable to Small Finance Banks.
The page text available does not set out the specific amendments, issue date or effective date.
The full text is available as a PDF (about 241 kb) on the RBI website.
who_is_affected: Small Finance Banks and their customers, particularly in relation to KYC and customer due diligence compliance.
action_required: Small Finance Banks should read the full Directions on the RBI website and update KYC policies, procedures and systems as needed.

RBI has issued the Reserve Bank of India (Small Finance Banks - Know Your Customer) Second Amendment Directions, 2026.

The Directions amend the KYC framework applicable to Small Finance Banks. The notification page lists the document, but the text available to us does not detail the specific changes, the issue date or the effective date.

Why it matters:

KYC norms underpin customer onboarding, due diligence and AML compliance. Any amendment can affect internal policies, onboarding workflows and audit checklists at Small Finance Banks.

What to do:

Compliance and risk teams should read the full Directions (available as a PDF on the RBI website), map the changes against existing KYC policies and plan updates accordingly.

Please verify the details with the official RBI source before acting.
